method_summary: This selector uses a round-dependent diversity weight with alpha=2.5 for rounds 1-12 (exploration) and alpha=1.5 for rounds 13-39 (exploitation), while keeping the candidate pool size at k*15 (the same as the current best). The earlier round-dependent variants that failed used different pool sizes or alpha thresholds; this variant tests the round-dependent alpha idea with the proven pool size and a shifted transition point.
